content: Each model is evaluated using two standard NLP metrics—micro and macro averaged F-scores, the harmonic mean of related metrics precision and recall. For each diagnostic category INLINEFORM0 from a set of 37 different classes INLINEFORM1 , the number of true positives INLINEFORM2 , false positives INLINEFORM3 , and false negatives INLINEFORM4 , the micro F-score is defined as DISPLAYFORM0
